process.title: Free intro call
process.description: We talk through your goals, audience and budget. You leave with clear next steps, even if we don't work together.

process.description: I handle deployment, domain and analytics, then stay available for fixes and improvements.

faq.question: How much does a website cost?
faq.answer: It depends on scope. After a short call I send a fixed quote, so you know the full price before any work starts.

faq.question: How long does a project take?
faq.answer: A business website usually takes 2 to 4 weeks. Web apps and stores depend on features; you get a timeline with the quote.

faq.question: Do you work with clients outside Georgia?
faq.answer: Yes. I work remotely with clients worldwide and communicate in English or Georgian over email, video call or messenger.

faq.question: Will I be able to update the site myself?
faq.answer: Yes. I can set up an easy editor for your content, and I hand over all code, accounts and a short walkthrough.

faq.question: What happens after launch?
faq.answer: Bugs found in the first 30 days are fixed free. After that I offer ongoing support if you need it.
